name: Peanuts
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as they're naturally FODMAP-free, though portion control is important due to high fat content.
preparationTips: Choose plain roasted or raw peanuts without added onion or garlic powder
Limit to recommended serving size to avoid digestive discomfort from high fat content
Store in airtight container to maintain freshness and prevent rancidity
Natural peanut butter (just peanuts and salt) is also low FODMAP at 2 tablespoons
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of niacin and folate
